_comment: Alfanumrik is deliberately NOT an installable PWA today. No service worker is registered anywhere in the app (apps/host/public/sw.js is a retirement tombstone that unregisters itself), so no install prompt can fire. This manifest is metadata-only: name, icons, colours, language. Do not re-add display:standalone, orientation, or screenshots without first shipping a real offline strategy — see the header of apps/host/public/sw.js and docs/runbooks/pwa-stale-service-worker-recovery.md section 8. NOTE: this static file is NOT what production serves — apps/host/src/proxy.ts rewrites /manifest.json to /api/school-config/manifest (per-tenant). Keep the two in sync.
name: Alfanumrik
description: Tonight's homework can be different. Foxy — India's most patient tutor for CBSE Grades 6–12, in Hindi and English. Free to start.
